note: Pairs that were promoted, shipped in a snapshot, and later removed. A pair is here because its key was unsafe as written - not because every correction it made was wrong. `justified_matches` says how many of its corpus matches were genuine misrecognitions, and `replaced_by` names the narrower key that took over where one exists. Downstream users should stop applying these keys and, where `replaced_by` is set, apply those instead.

withdrawn.why: Two syllables that occur inside longer words - the counterexample was 하스 spoken within 하이퍼스케일러들. Its own right-hand side is also another pair's wrong form (하이닉스 → SK하이닉스, disabled upstream), so it corrected one misrecognition into another. No narrower form of the key is safe.

The same misheard token stands for two different correct forms in this corpus: SPV (special purpose vehicle) and S&P. A dictionary cannot choose between them, and guessing either way damages the other.

바위 is the ordinary word for rock. 34 of its 71 corpus matches were genuine - the misrecognition of 바이오 in a pharma context - and the rest were the plain noun, mostly in road metaphors. Narrowed rather than dropped: the longer key keeps the genuine half and cannot reach the rest.

The key spanned a word boundary into 소부장 단위 / 소부장 단에, which is ordinary usage - 2 of 44 matches. Replaced upstream by six inflected keys that cannot reach those forms; the trade costs about 12 uninflected occurrences and removes both wrong ones.

The key fires inside 삼성자산운용, turning the asset manager's name into 삼성전자산운용 - 35 of its 1,215 matches across 1,904 videos. The other 1,180 were genuine, which is why it survived an earlier review at 2.2%; upstream chose the safer trade this time because Korean gives the replacer no word boundary to stop at. Five particle-suffixed keys replace it and cannot reach 삼성자산, and they cover 236 of those matches - a deliberate loss of coverage to remove the damage.
